title: Repair and Emergency Service Calls: Invoice Payment Terms Schedule
content:
The payment settings of a service invoice under Repair and Emergency Service Calls are the same in every call class.

| Call class | Invoice due after completion | Calendar days after completion after which an unpaid balance accrues a late-payment charge | Late-payment charge per 30-day period on the unpaid balance | Smallest late-payment charge posted |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Standard Service Call | 0 days (due on completion) | 30 | 1.5 percent | $2.00 |
| Same-Day Priority Service Call | 0 days (due on completion) | 30 | 1.5 percent | $2.00 |
| Evening Service Call | 0 days (due on completion) | 30 | 1.5 percent | $2.00 |
| Weekend Service Call | 0 days (due on completion) | 30 | 1.5 percent | $2.00 |
| Overnight Emergency Service Call | 0 days (due on completion) | 30 | 1.5 percent | $2.00 |
| Holiday Emergency Service Call | 0 days (due on completion) | 30 | 1.5 percent | $2.00 |

A due figure of 0 days means the invoice is due on completion. The late-payment percentage is stated per 30-day period of the unpaid balance. The $2.00 figure is the smallest late-payment charge that is posted.
